  simp_rw [mem_def, sInter_apply]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, rfl, _⟩ := H z (coe_mem.2 hz)
  refine ⟨y, rfl, fun w hxw => ?_⟩
  simpa only [coe_mem, coe_apply] using H w (coe_mem.2 hxw)
